text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The statue of the Three Goddesses, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can become a dignified 
Umamusume like this statue someday...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh, what was that? There's a voice... 
inside my head—"
